parsed.summary: The patch addresses the input validation issue by allowing non-float dtypes, but it may introduce unintended behavior or compatibility issues.

issues.description: The change allows non-float dtypes, which might break existing code that assumes float inputs. This could lead to unexpected behavior or errors in other parts of the codebase.
